title: Test Strategy & Operations Lead for Regression Testing - S/4E Program
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 This role is being created as an addition to the ERP Competence Centre to address the increased quantity and complexity of testing requirements driven by the S4E program rollout. You will be critical in establishing a robust testing framework for a multi\-year, dynamic project phase, with a focus on developing and governing the overall test strategy for Regression (REG) and Non\-Functional Requirements (NFR), overseeing the operational management of all related testing activities, and managing the phased transition of these services to the permanent AMS/Operations team. As an expert\-level professional, you will bring extensive experience in large\-scale ERP test management, particularly within SAP environments, with a proven ability to define complex test strategies, manage vendor\-led execution, and lead service transition initiatives.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* 40% Test Strategy \& Governance
+ Develop, implement, and own the end\-to\-end test strategy for Regression (REG) and Non\-Functional Requirements (NFR) across the S4E program.
+ Define and establish standards, processes, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for test execution, defect management, and quality reporting.
+ Determine testing scope, entry/exit criteria, and quality gates for various S4E project rollout phases.
+ Collaborate with solution architects and functional teams to ensure test scenarios provide comprehensive coverage of critical business processes and technical specifications.

* 40% Test Operations \& Execution Management
+ Oversee the planning and execution of all REG and NFR test cycles, coordinating activities between internal teams and the external AMS partner.
+ Manage the provisioning and maintenance of required test environments, test data, and testing tools for the S4E program.
+ Monitor test progress, analyze results for trends and risks, and provide regular, clear status reports to program leadership and key stakeholders.
+ Lead the triage and root cause analysis of critical defects and performance bottlenecks, driving resolution with development and infrastructure teams.

title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
description:
**Job Summary**
 This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross\-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less\-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross\-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
   

  

**Competencies**
 Product Failure Mode Avoidance \- Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
   

  

 Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis \- Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub\-system and/or component level requirements.
   

  

 Product Platform Planning and Architecting \- Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade\-off analysis in collaboration with life\-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.
   

  

 Product Software Design and Construction \- Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.
   

  

 Product Verification and Validation Management \- Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
   

  

 System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
   

  

 Systems Thinking \- Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
   

  

 Builds networks \- Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
   

  

 Communicates effectively \- Developing and delivering multi\-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
   

  

 Decision quality \- Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
   

  

 Drives results \- Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
   

  

 Manages complexity \- Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
   

  

 Resourcefulness \- Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
   

  

 Values differences \- Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
   

  

**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
 College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
   

  

 Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
   

  

 This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
   

  

**Experience**
 Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred
   

  

**Resposibilities**
* Develop embedded fuel systems controls software per requirements
* Follow all Cummins internal software processes while developing embedded fuel system controls software
* Modify existing software implementation to support the software change
* Verify and document evidence of the software change functioning correctly
* Solve the software related problems by determining the root cause
* Generate a solution to fix the problem identified and verify on test bench
* Highlight software integration changes to peers in a timely manner
* Support global software team to deliver software for global engine programs
* Align with global software development functional excellence practices
* The work will include development in both ‘C’ code as well as in Simulink models.Other tools used for development will include the use of a Cummins proprietary data dictionary and build tool, configuration management tools as well as test tools (oscilloscopes, frequency generators, debuggers, etc.…)


**Skills – Functional/Technical**
* MTech or BTech Electrical Engineering or computer science with embedded controls development focus preferred
* 7 to 9 years industry experience or equivalent academic experience in development of automotive controls software
* Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for model\-based development.
* Experience with programming in C or other imperative and procedural languages.
* Understanding of diesel engines, mechanical systems, especially fuel systems and air handling systems is a plus
* Good communication and presentation skills required for documenting software design, test results and observations
* Experience or familiarity with microprocessor based embedded control system development
* Understanding of AUTOSAR

title: Senior Performance Test Engineer
description:
**About Position:** 




  





 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Performance Test Engineer with a strong background in performance testing for large\-scale enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with K6 and will be adept at building performance test frameworks from scratch. This role involves integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines and validating application behavior during peak load conditions, particularly in the context of complex on\-premises to Azure cloud migration programs.
 



  




* **Role: Senior Performance Test Engineer**
* **Location: Pune, Hyderabad**
* **Experience: 6 to 10 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**



  





**What You'll Do:** 




  




* Design and execute performance test scenarios including load, stress, soak, and spike testing using K6 against Azure environments.
* Capture baseline performance metrics on legacy/on\-premises environments and validate performance parity on Azure infrastructure.
* Validate application behavior under 150% of peak load conditions and verify autoscaling configurations.
* Monitor, analyze, and report p99 latency against defined SLA requirements.
* Prepare and manage large\-scale test datasets to accurately simulate production workloads.
* Integrate K6 performance tests into GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines for automated execution.
* Leverage monitoring and APM tools such as Datadog and Azure Monitor to identify bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations.
* Execute end\-to\-end performance validation across Dev, Test, Stage, and Production environments.
* Document performance trends, findings, and recommendations for technical and business stakeholders.



  





**Expertise You'll Bring:** 




  




* 6 to 10 years of dedicated experience in performance and load testing.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with K6 performance testing framework.
* Proficiency in JavaScript for K6 scripting and framework development.
* Experience building performance testing frameworks from scratch.
* Strong experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands\-on expertise with GitHub Actions and test automation practices.
* Familiarity with Azure services including App Services, Azure SQL, and private endpoints.
* Experience with monitoring and APM tools such as Datadog, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify performance bottlenecks and root causes.
* Experience conducting load, stress, spike, and soak testing for enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of performance baseline analysis and migration validation activities.
* Experience validating cloud scalability, autoscaling behavior, and application resiliency.
* Strong understanding of API performance testing and service\-level validation.
* Familiarity with JMeter or LoadRunner and the ability to translate traditional testing concepts into K6\-based frameworks.
* Experience with Azure Load Testing services.
* Knowledge of .NET enterprise applications and API\-level performance testing.
* Experience with Postman and Newman for API validation.
* Domain knowledge in Payroll or BFSI environments is an advantage.
* Experience configuring and managing self\-hosted GitHub Actions runners.
* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with development, DevOps, infrastructure, and product teams.
* Commitment to delivering scalable, reliable, and high\-performing enterprise applications through robust performance engineering practices.



  





**Benefits:** 




  




* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

title: Professional Services Engineer, Actimize
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
   

  

 So, what's the role all about?
   

  

 As a Professional Services Engineer, you will join a dynamic, customer\-facing team responsible for implementing and delivering NICE Actimize Financial Crime Prevention solutions for leading global financial institutions. You will play a critical role in configuring, customizing, deploying, and supporting Actimize solutions across Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Payments Fraud, and Trading Compliance domains.
   

  

 In this role, you will work closely with customers, business analysts, solution architects, and implementation teams to understand business requirements and deliver intelligent, scalable, and innovative solutions. You will gain exposure to complex regulatory compliance challenges while working with the market leader in Financial Crime and Compliance technology.
   

  

 How will you make an impact?
   

  

 Solution Development \& Implementation
   

  

* Develop, configure, and customize product features according to solution designs and enterprise software standards.
* Implement and configure NICE Actimize applications for customer\-specific requirements.
* Setup new environments and deploy solutions across development, testing, and production environments.
* Independently develop and deliver enterprise\-grade software features and functionalities.
* Participate in solution design discussions and technical implementation planning.

* Support customers by troubleshooting and resolving functional and technical issues.
* Work directly with customer stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
* Collaborate with R\&D, Professional Services, Customer Support, and other internal teams to ensure successful delivery outcomes.
* Participate in customer deployments and occasionally support customer engagements across different time zones.


 Engineering Excellence \& Innovation
   

  

* Develop utilities, tools, and automation solutions that improve delivery efficiency and operational scalability.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams within Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, and implementation practices.
* Maintain high\-quality standards while working in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.


 Have you got what it takes?
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* BE/B.Tech or equivalent degree with relevant practical experience.
* 4 to 6 years of experience in software implementation, customization, or enterprise application development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SQL and PostgreSQL databases.
* Experience handling large\-scale data volumes and complex database environments.
* Experience working with Oracle, MS SQL Server, or PostgreSQL.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working in global and matrix\-based environments.
* Exposure to Unix/Linux environments and command\-line operations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical ability with a self\-learning mindset.
* Ability to work independently and deliver complex assignments with minimal supervision.
* Experience developing secure, scalable, multi\-user enterprise software applications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, Pods, and DevOps practices.
* Exposure to cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Previous experience in Professional Services, implementation, or customer\-facing technical roles.
* Experience or knowledge of NICE Actimize platform development.
* Familiarity with enterprise application deployment and environment setup.


 What makes you stand out?
   

  

* Excellent attention to detail and task management skills.
* Proven ability to operate successfully in complex delivery environments.
* Strong collaboration skills with technical and business stakeholders.
* Passion for learning new technologies and solving complex customer challenges.
* Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast\-paced, and customer\-focused environments.

 Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

 At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face\-to\-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000\+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3\+ billion financial transactions.*

title: AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Shape ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI**
* Architect and evolve the platform suite across both engines: the 18\-agent ZenseAI.QI stack (DeepSpeci, CaseGeni, Auto\-PlayPilot, DataGeni, Secure\-Xi, Perf\-Xi, Insights360, RIA and Accessibility Intelligence) and the four\-pillar ZenseAI.AssureAI framework (Data Quality, Model Evaluation, Trustworthiness, and Scalability \& Security).
* Design and refine the archetype\-specific assurance lifecycles for Classical ML, Generative AI and Agentic AI, including the signature eight\-axis agentic trajectory scorecard graded on every run.
* Keep the platforms LLM\-agnostic and deployable on any client stack — on\-prem, cloud or hybrid — as model\-mixing and constant provider churn become the market norm.
* Own technical roadmap decisions for accelerators such as the Agentic Foundry (a 25\-blueprint reference matrix) and the curated, swap\-ready tooling ecosystem around each archetype.


**Lead Evaluation\-Driven Development**
* Build and govern eval suites — ground\-truth Q\&A sets, LLM\-as\-judge rubrics, frozen baselines — that gate every release rather than validate it after the fact.
* Own trajectory grading, red/purple/blue\-team probes and safety attestations for agentic and generative systems, and drift monitoring and fairness audits for classical ML.
* Translate evaluation results into release decisions: eval\-threshold gates, red\-team severity floors, canary and shadow deployments, and rollback rehearsals.
* Bring evaluation\-driven development practice into client engagements — showing, not just telling, how a live harness beats a one\-time audit.


**Own Presales and Client Proposals**
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs and client proposals across both engines, translating client requirements into a defensible solution architecture and commercial structure.
* Architect engagements across the full ladder — AI QA Assessment, AI QA Transformation, Managed AI QA — and fast\-starts such as the LLM Health Check, Agent Stress Test and Compliance Sprint.
* Build estimates, staffing plans and technical win themes that hold up under client and internal scrutiny, across client\-managed, risk\-reward and Zensar\-managed commercial models.


**Present and Articulate Value to Clients**
* Present the ZenseAI.QI and ZenseAI.AssureAI value proposition directly to client stakeholders — from QA Directors and Heads of AI/ML Engineering to CTOs, Chief Risk Officers and Chief AI Officers — adapting the narrative to each audience.
* Lead client workshops and technical walkthroughs, including guiding a CIO through the Agentic Foundry in a single session.
* Build and deliver executive trust scorecards and portfolio risk heat maps that make the assurance story board\-ready.


**Represent Zensar in Client Captives for Sales**
* Present live in client captive sessions and sales pursuits as the senior technical voice for Quality Intelligence, alongside account and sales leadership.
* Run and narrate proof\-of\-concept demonstrations that turn a client's stated risk into a small, credible proof — the practice's proof\-first approach to closing.
* Represent the practice at partner and industry forums as the practice's thought leadership and pipeline develop.


**Build Practice IP and Mentor the Next Generation**
* Contribute reusable accelerators, reference architectures and industry packs across BFSI, TMT, and Manufacturing \& Retail back into the practice's IP base.
* Mentor and help build out the practice's emerging AI\-specialist roles — Prompt Engineer, LLM\-Eval Engineer, Agent Architect, Trajectory Eval Engineer, Knowledge/RAG Engineer, AI Security Analyst and Adversarial Red/Blue Team Lead.
* Support GenAI and AI\-enablement training for QI associates across the practice.


**Responsibilities**

* Working architectural knowledge of agentic AI systems: multi\-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and the operational risks specific to agents — unauthorised tool calls, trajectory drift, memory leakage across accounts.
* Direct experience with evaluation\-driven development: building or governing eval suites, LLM\-as\-judge frameworks, ground\-truth datasets, frozen baselines and red\-teaming / adversarial testing for generative or agentic systems.
* Strong client\-interfacing capability: comfortable owning technical content in an RFP response, presenting to CXO\-level stakeholders, and holding the room in a live client or sales captive setting.

**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.

* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****

* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.

description:

In this role, you will collaborate with talented engineers to solve complex challenges in cutting\-edge technology. You will then help build new solutions that improve productivity, tracking, and operational efficiency.
   

  

 The position needs new hire to work onsite from the office in Pune, India.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Utilize various certification kits to test software and hardware features of our products, ensuring certification\-level quality across all stages of the development cycle, from emulation to production. This includes a wide range of functional areas such as graphics, display, audio, multimedia, USB, hypervisors, and virtual machines.

* Work actively with existing UI and automation tools by integrating internal and external APIs, formulate and deploy multi\-agent systems to optimize existing workflows and to build new automated solutions.

* Drive operational excellence by defining and improving processes, using innovative problem\-solving methods to increase organizational efficiency and support strategic goals.
* Represent the team in internal meetings such as release planning, bug scrubs, and project status reviews, as well as external discussions with certification authorities and partners.
* Engage with software development teams when reporting certification bugs, providing key debugging information and data points to help drive timely closure.

* Become a champion of quality for every NVIDIA product you work on, and help promote that same mindset across the team and cross\-functional organizations.


**What We Need To See**
* Engineering degree in Computer Science, IT, ECE, or a related field, with strong academic performance.
* 5\+ years of total experience with excellent programming skills in Python and C\#, including the ability to write logical scripts and code from scratch.
* Demonstrated ability to design, build, and deploy AI/ML and agentic AI solutions to accelerate automation development and testing workflows.
* Strong familiarity with AI\-native development tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and LLM APIs to improve engineering velocity.

* Ability to manage conflicting or changing priorities while maintaining a positive attitude in an ambitious and dynamic environment.
* Ability to work with geographically dispersed teams and attend reviews or meetings to maintain alignment.

 Role

title: TECHNICAL LEAD L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 **Role Purpose** 

 The purpose of this role is to facilitate application solutions by developing and  reviewing module\-level codes, creating replication patterns, performing root cause analysis to identify recurring issues and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure stable, well\-documented deliverables that meet business objectives. 
 


 ͏
 
 Areas of responsibility
 



 Gathering of requirements\-Participate in gathering requirements for specific modules and ensure clear, structured documentation. Work across multiple business processes to capture linkages, dependencies, and required changes.
 


 ͏
 
 Solution Design\-Facilitate creation of application solution designs for a specific module under the guidance of the Project Manager, ensuring alignment with business requirements and technical standards.
 


 ͏
 
 Coding and Configuration\-"Review the developed codes, resolve technical queries of the team for the assigned module and create consistent replication patterns, to ensure that the developed code aligns with the project standards.Collaborate with project managers through all phases of software development life cycle."
 


 ͏
 
 Perform root\-cause analysis to identify and troubleshoot recurring technical issues. Modify software codes to resolve errors, adapt to new hardware and software, enhance performance, and upgrade interfaces."

title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:** 
 GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* **Delivery toolchain:** 
 GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* **Integrations:** 
 ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

title: SVP - Technical Lead - Equity Technology
description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
 Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
   

  

**IT Equities Technology**
 Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real\-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed \& OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front\-office workflows end\-to\-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real\-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
   

  

 Operating in a 24x7 follow\-the\-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high\-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C\+\+/C\#, cloud, modern visualization, low\-latency messaging, and in\-memory data stores.

 Jefferies India is seeking a technically strong and delivery\-focused Senior Developer to join the Equities Technology – Equity Derivatives team in Pune. This role will help drive engineering excellence across key initiatives delivered from India, while collaborating closely with technology stakeholders and senior engineers across London and New York.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on development expertise in Java, solid experience with enterprise technologies, strong SQL/database skills, and exposure to cloud, CI/CD, and DevOps practices. Experience in Investment Banking / Financial Services, particularly Equity Derivatives, would be highly valuable. Exposure to or willingness to code in C\# is preferred.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable, maintainable, and high\-quality software systems.

* Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and long\-term maintainability of systems.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of software development experience, with recent experience in a senior or lead development role.
* Strong proficiency in Java and enterprise application development.
* Experience with, or willingness to additionally code in, C\#.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database design.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and modern software delivery methods.
* Proven experience delivering scalable, maintainable, and reliable software systems.
* Strong understanding of software design principles, architecture, and development best practices.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders across multiple time zones.


**Preferred / Nice To Have**
* Experience in Investment Banking / Financial Services, ideally within Equity Derivatives.
* Experience with microservices and event\-driven architectures.
* Background in mentoring junior developers and supporting team capability development.
* Exposure to modern observability, monitoring, and production support practices.


**Education**
* Undergraduate degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.


**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. title: Tools Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a qualified Software Tools Development Engineer to join our GPU SWQA team. The successful candidate will have strong experience applying AI technologies to automate test cases and a deep understanding of Windows operating systems. Extensive knowledge of GPU, CPU, SoC, x86, and ARM architectures is required, along with expertise in PC I/O architecture and common bus interfaces such as PCIe, USB, and SATA. Familiarity with specifications for general PC architecture components is a plus.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on windows platforms.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python, C\# or equivalent which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain. Develop and implement automated and manual tests, analyze results, identify and report defects.
* Rigorously drive test automation initiative. Build innovative ways to automate and expand our software testing.
* Expose defects and constraints; Isolate and debug the issue(s) and find the root cause; Contribute to the solution and drive to closure. Measure code coverage for the software under test, analyze and drive code coverage enhancements.
* Develop applications and tools that accelerate development and test workflows and write fast, effective, maintainable, reliable and well documented code. Generate and test compatibility across a range of products and interfaces and validate different key software applications across a test matrix designed to test both breadth and depth.
* Provide peer code reviews including feedback on performance, scalability and correctness.
* Report test coverage and Go/No\-Go status for deliverables, escalate critical issues, and drive them to closure.
* Participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions to continuously improve deliverable quality, workflows, and processes.
* Effectively estimate and prioritize tasks in order to create a realistic delivery schedule.
* You will have the opportunity to work on challenging technical and process issues and work closely with leadership to report progress, generating effective and actionable reports.
* This is a fully onsite position.


**What We Need To See**
* B.S / B.Tech/M.S in Computer Science / Electronics \& Telecommunication with strong academics or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of programming experience in Python, C\# or equivalent with experience in applying Object\-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Hands\-on experience developing Python scripts using application development concepts like dictionaries, tuples, RegEx, PIP etc.
* Working experience with databases and storage technologies like SQL, MongoDB and Elasticsearch.
* Experience working on Windows OS with a solid understanding of GPU, CPU, and SoC architectures.
* Experience using AI tools to automate test cases as well as end\-to\-end QA workflow.
* Strong communication skills, including effective interpersonal and cross\-team collaboration.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Highly organized, proactive, and quick to learn.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams in a fast\-paced environment.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, including the ability to apply sound logic when isolating and regressing issues, along with strong written communication skills.
* Extensive experience with AI\-driven automation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team environment.
* Development experience fixing regression bugs and implementing or enabling tests for CI/CD pipelines.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

description:
**Description**
 The Test SME brings AI\-native quality engineering expertise to the enablement squad. They transform how squads approach testing — moving from manual, labour\-intensive test practices to AI\-augmented quality workflows where Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) generates test cases, identifies coverage gaps, and maintains regression suites, enabling squads to ship faster with higher confidence.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Strong quality engineering background with experience across unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end testing strategies
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling — Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline, Aider): writing custom skills for test automation, building subagents for coverage analysis, and configuring MCP servers for test infrastructure
   

  

 Experience with modern test frameworks and tooling (Jest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar) and the ability to integrate AI tooling alongside them
   

  

 Understanding of AI\-native SDLC practices and how testing must evolve when code is generated or augmented by AI
   

  

 Experience with test architecture at scale — knowing when to test, what to test, and how to maintain fast feedback loops in large codebases
   

  

 Ability to coach engineers on testing practices — shifting quality left and making testing a shared responsibility rather than a bottleneck
   

  

 Comfortable assessing unfamiliar codebases and quickly identifying the highest\-impact quality improvements
   

  

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**
 Experience with property\-based testing, mutation testing, or formal verification approaches
   

  

 Background in performance or reliability engineering (load testing, chaos engineering, SRE practices)
   

  

 Familiarity with contract testing in microservice architectures (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract)
   

  

 Experience in financial services quality assurance (regulatory testing requirements, audit trails)
   

  

 Experience defining and tracking quality metrics (defect escape rate, test cycle time, coverage trends)
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Assess the engineering team’s current testing maturity during the discovery phase — identifying gaps in coverage, slow feedback loops, and manual bottlenecks that block rapid delivery
   

  

 Design and implement AI\-native testing strategies: using Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) to generate test cases from requirements, analyse coverage gaps, and detect regression risks
   

  

 Build custom Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) skills and subagents focused on quality engineering — automated test generation, test data management, and intelligent test selection
   

  

 Define quality gates within the AI\-native SDLC that provide fast, automated feedback without creating delivery drag
   

  

 Embed testing best practices into product squads through pairing, code review, and hands\-on demonstration
   

  

 Create reusable testing patterns (frameworks, templates, agent configurations) that are made centrally available for use across all engineering teams
   

  

 Work alongside squad developers to ensure AI\-generated code meets quality standards and that testing keeps pace with accelerated delivery
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:**

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

title: SENIOR QUALITY ENGINEERING LEAD (TESTING) - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Quality Engineering professional to lead testing delivery for services and programmes within the organisation. This role is responsible for ensuring high\-quality test outcomes, managing stakeholder expectations, driving efficiency through resource optimisation, and shaping the strategic direction for service expansion and new implementations. The individual will play a key role in aligning testing practices with business priorities, risks, and delivery timelines.

 Define, review, and assure the quality of test strategies, scenarios, test cases, and regression coverage.
   

  

 Collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders including development, architecture, product, delivery, and business teams to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria.

 Identify, assess, and communicate quality risks, ensuring test approaches align with business impact and technical complexity.
   

  

 Review test results, documentation, and audit\-related artefacts to ensure compliance and quality standards.

 Coach and support teams on testing best practices, application knowledge, and business\-critical workflows.
   

  

 Ensure knowledge capture, documentation, and effective sharing across teams.

 Skilled in stakeholder engagement, reporting, and team collaboration.
   

  

 Experienced in service delivery, process optimisation, and driving efficiency outcomes.

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to lead strategic quality engineering initiatives within a global telecom environment.
   

  

 Exposure to large\-scale transformation programmes and diverse stakeholder ecosystems.
   

  

 Experience in driving innovation, automation, and process excellence in testing practices.
   

  

 Opportunity to influence quality standards and service delivery outcomes at scale.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced stakeholder and service delivery management in global environments.
   

  

 Strategic quality engineering and risk\-based testing approaches.
   

  

 Resource optimisation and capacity planning at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Implementation of modern QA practices including automation and DevOps integration.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

title: Software Consultant
description:
**Department:** 
 Development
 



**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  




**Description**
**ParentPay Group** 
 is the largest EdTech company in Europe with over 1000 employees and more than £130m turnover. The group has a portfolio of software solutions for educational establishments which serve their management, payments, catering and library service needs.
   

 PPG is also the largest provider of school management software in the UK and touches the lives of over one million people every day, streamlining school administration and management to free up time for teaching and learning, with its market\-leading SIMS software solution
   

 SIMS is at the heart of 19,000 schools, including over 700 independent and international schools in 49 countries.
   

  

**What we are doing**
 We are developing a new single authentication solution that will be integrated and used by all products within the ParentPay Group.
   

 A new team will be forming and will be working under a DevSecOps culture using eXtreme Programming techniques, ensuring the highest standards of quality, security and delivery are met.
   

 The product will pass through a formal Service Transition process into live support, but the team should also have a firm focus on live service operations and where they fit into 3rd line support.
   

**Job Description**
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Consultant who is passionate about building products that deliver exceptional customer experience. You will contribute towards creating test scenarios, manual Testing, automating the scenarios and benchmarking the performance of products and services in the ParentPay group portfolio.
   

 You will be responsible for understanding the domain as well as technical intricacies of the product working on the product backlog, and aid in delivery acceleration through creative thinking, an evidence\-based approach and a keen focus on user and business value.
   

  

 The product will deliver a new Auth Solution for all group products, so alongside customer facing elements there will need to be a firm technical foundation. A solid understanding of technical principles and an ability to converse and work with solutions and technical requirements is therefore essential to success.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 • Develop understanding of the Domain and technical intricacies of the product.
   

 • Consistently evaluate and become the expert in the domain space.
   

 • Collaborate with the product stakeholders to understand the Acceptance criteria thoroughly.
   

 • Build robust UI/UX solution using .NET, C\#, Microservices, HTML, CSS technologies.
   

 • Would need to work on Azure B2C implementation.
   

 • Strong understanding of architectural principles
   

 • Understanding of oauth api call sequence
   

 • Strong Agile Development Practices
   

 • Ability to work in a technical environment. Should have experience with Whitebox testing techniques.
   

 • Demonstrate clarity of thought and the ability to translate the complex into simple and consistent terms.
   

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
 Essential Skills
 * .NET 8 or later
* Azure ecosystem (ADO)
* C\#
* Strong understanding of architectural principles
* Strong understanding of API Design
* Agile Development Practices


 Desired Skills
 * k8s
* kiuwan or similar for security testing
* JUnit or similar for unit testing

title: SAP CML Test Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: SAP CML Test Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
* As an SAP CML Test Engineer, you will be a crucial member of our cross\-functional team, ensuring the quality, stability, and performance of our core Lending applications. You will leverage your expertise in both mortgages business processes and SAP CML to design, execute, and document comprehensive testing strategies. You will collaborate closely with Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers in both Pune and Frankfurt to verify and secure the technology solutions that support Deutsche Bank's lending operations.
* The Lending Platforms team is a global unit responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of Deutsche Bank's core lending systems. As a critical function within our Private Bank Technology division, we manage the lifecycle of loan products on the SAP CML (Consumer and Mortgage Loans) platform. Our team is strategically located in Frankfurt and Pune, fostering a collaborative, multinational environment to deliver robust and innovative solutions for our business partners.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Test Strategy and Planning: Deliver a strong contribution with the test team, which will develop, document, and maintain functional and non\-functional test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on business requirements and technical specifications.
* Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests for SAP CML and integrated systems, covering all phases of testing including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Regression Testing.
* Defect Management: Identify, log, and track defects with precision. Collaborate with development teams to analyze root causes and ensure timely resolution and re\-testing.
* Domain Expertise: Apply your in\-depth knowledge of the mortgages business lifecycle (origination, servicing, closure) to create/manage realistic and effective test scenarios.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work in close partnership with a multi\-national team of Requirements Engineers, Developers and Application Managers across Pune and Frankfurt to ensure a shared understanding of requirements and quality standards.
* Reporting and Documentation: Contribute to providing clear, concise, and timely reporting on test progress, defect status, and overall quality to project stakeholders. Maintain comprehensive test documentation.
* Process Improvement: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing processes, methodologies, and tools.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* SAP CML Expertise: Proven, hands\-on experience in testing SAP Consumer and Mortgage Loans (CML) module. Strong understanding of CML configuration, processes, and integration points.
* Testing Proficiency: Minimum of 2\+ years in a dedicated software testing role with a strong grasp of QA methodologies, tools, and processes (STLC, SDLC).
* Mortgages Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of the end\-to\-end mortgage lending business process, from application and underwriting to servicing and securitization.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed, multi\-national team environment across different time zones.
* Analytical Mindset: Analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


**Advantageous / Nice to Have**
* Test Management Tools: Familiarity with test management tools, particularly Tricentis Test, for planning and tracking test execution.
* Test Automation Tools: Hands\-on experience with test automation frameworks, especially Tricentis Tosca, for creating and maintaining automated test suites.
* Certifications: ISTQB/ISEB or other relevant software testing certifications.
* Agile Experience: Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.
* Broader SAP Knowledge: Experience with other SAP Banking Services modules (e.g., SAP BP, BCA) or FI/CO is a plus.
* German language skills: would be regarded as a plus point.


**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.


**About Us And Our Teams**
 Please visit our company website for further information:
   

  

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

title: Principal  Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**Principal Engineer** 
**About the Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Principal Engineer**

**Must Have**

 At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.
   

  

**About Us**
 Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high\-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency \- have more time to care.
   

  

 We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.
   

  

**About The Role**
 A Senior Technical Lead – SDET is responsible for driving end\-to\-end quality engineering, test strategy, and delivery excellence for complex software systems. This role combines test leadership, hands\-on technical expertise, and stakeholder collaboration, ensuring that products meet high quality, reliability, and performance standards.
   

  

 The role expects strong technical depth, owning test planning, execution, automation strategy, and continuous improvement, while proactively collaborating with cross\-functional stakeholders and customers.
   

  

**Technical Skills\-**
* Strong expertise in Automation Testing and QA processes
* UI Automation: Selenium / Playwright with C\#
* Automation Framework Development
* API Testing using C\# or relevant frameworks
* Performance Testing using JMeter
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools
* Strong database knowledge (SQL Server or equivalent)
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing


**With us you will be responsible for**
* Define and drive test strategy, test approach, and quality assurance processes for multiple products
* Lead test planning, estimation, scheduling, and execution across system testing, UAT, and releases
* Ensure comprehensive test coverage using risk\-based and data\-driven testing approaches
* Own test artifacts including test plans, test cases, test data, and test reports


**Quality Engineering \& Automation**
* Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks and solutions
* Drive AI\-first and automation\-first approach across UI, API, and performance testing
* Guide team in test design, reusable assets, and best engineering practices
* Continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, and defect detection capability


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Customer Focus**
* Collaborate proactively with product owners, developers, architects, and customers
* Provide clear communication on quality status, risks, and mitigation plans
* Understand customer business needs and propose effective testing approaches
* Support pre\-sales activities by contributing to solutioning and test strategy proposals for PRF’s.


**Team Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers and SDETs
* Guide team members in automation and manual testing practices
* Build capability through coaching, knowledge sharing, and continuous feedback
* Ensure effective team organization, planning, and delivery ownership


**Defect Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Analyze defects and guide teams in root cause analysis and prevention strategies
* Provide actionable feedback to development teams to improve product quality
* Drive process improvements and best practices in line with Agile and DevOps models
* Support reproduction and analysis of complex/rare defects


**We expect you to have**
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in software testing / quality engineering
* At least 3–5 years of experience as Test Lead / Test Manager
* Proven experience in test design, execution, stakeholder collaboration, and team leadership
* Strong ability to handle complex systems, demanding scenarios, and multi\-team coordination
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments


**What’s in it for you?**
 In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture. We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
   

  

 Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in.
   

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion \| Sustainability \| Tieto
   

  

**Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud \| Tieto Blog

title: Member of Technical Staff 3 (QA+ System Testing+ Scalability+ Performance + Kubernetes)4–6 years
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Nutanix, a leader in enterprise hybrid cloud, is looking to hire a curious and innovative SDET with experience in automation development and execution to qualify our Data Hub product/features. The role is tasked with test planning, test case development, and test execution strategy to assess and improve the overall quality of our products in the AI/ML area. This requires close collaboration with Development, UI/UX engineers, and the PM team. The role encompasses influencing product design by leveraging broad knowledge of the product portfolio and ensuring a quality\-first mindset.
   

  

**Nutanix Data Hub (NDH) team**
 Nutanix Data Hub (NDH) offers our customers simplicity and ease of use to build and grow their AI/ML adoption faster and realize rapid ROI, by providing intelligent operations, self service and orchestration, visibility and governance of spend, security and teams, all through a unified Multi\-cloud management solution. The AI/ML platform ensures that any enterprise data used by AI systems is clean, safe, compliant, and reliable. The system should manage the complete AI data lifecycle, including ingestion, curation, governance, quality, and delivery to AI systems. The end goal of the system is that all data must pass permission checks, quality validation, and PII sanitization before entering vector databases (for performing semantic searches) or for Large Language Model (LLM) training. NDH also enhances financial accountability, offering cost governance, resource optimization, and clear cloud metering and chargeback visibility. Moreover, it unifies security operations across clouds, automating incident response through intelligent analysis and compliance tools.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Develop test plan design and test case development for performance, load \& scale testing of NDH products.
* Define automation plan and test strategy within release timelines.
* End\-to\-end product quality ownership with all aspects of the test, automation, and delivery of the feature set at scale.
* Improve existing automated tests and overall automated test execution efficiency.
* Maintain a high overall quality index(QI) for the product/features at all times.
* Ability to delve deeper into debugging product issues with development engineers.
* Involve providing active feedback to improve the overall product experience.
* Debugging, filing bugs, and tracking them to closure.


**What Will You Bring**
* Minimum of 4\+yrs\-7yrs of experience in QA(System Test), Automation using Python (python preferred)
* BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent field.
* In depth working knowledge of Linux system interactions and Distributed Systems
* Deeper understanding of SW platform performance, load, scaling features.
* Deeper understanding of KS8 platform performance, load, scaling features.
* Experience with Python API test framework development.
* Working knowledge of virtualization \- VMware, KVM, or Hyper\-V
* Familiarity with version control systems such as GIT, build management tools, and Continuous Integration tools such as Jenkins/CircleCI
* Testing experience with monitoring/cloud products is a plus
* Detail\-oriented, self\-driven, and good verbal and written communication skills.


**Meet the hiring manager**
 Hello, this is Subu TK! I joined Nutanix almost 10 years ago and worked with several teams and roles during this time. I had been tech lead for the Nutanix Files QA team for several years, before taking over the responsibility of managing and owning the NDH QA team end\-to\-end. During my tenure at Nutanix, I got a wonderful opportunity to qualify/automate several key projects starting from NFS Server, SMB Server, RBAC, API, and Tiering. Also I was involved in defining CICD workflow and building tools to automate the entire process. Our team comprises versatile skill set expertise, full of energetic, and fun filled professional engineers. We are actively working on scaling up the NDH features and the Team. Looking forward to hiring a highly collaborative, skillful, curious, innovative and motivated engineer to automate/qualify product releases with very high quality to delight our customers.
   

  

**What The Team Says**
 Our team is a highly collaborative, skilled, and friendly group of engineers who foster a culture of learning, knowledge sharing and ownership. This creates an environment where any problem can be solved efficiently and effectively. Several innovative solutions are built in our automation code that brings out more efficiency to the overall qualification process. Along the way it provides a lot of renewed opportunity for professional development, growth and a sense of achievement.
   

  

**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Requires in\-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub\-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the function and overall business. Evaluates moderately complex and variable issues with substantial potential impact, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information. Requires good analytical skills in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Regularly assumes informal/formal leadership role within teams. Involved in coaching and training of new recruits Significant impact in terms of project size, geography, etc. by influencing decisions through advice, counsel and/or facilitating services to others in area of specialization. Work and performance of all teams in the area are directly affected by the performance of the individual.

* Requires sound and comprehensive communication and diplomacy skills to exchange complex information.
* Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
