title: Senior Automation Tester / Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Profile: Quantum Integrators is an international strategy and business consulting group whose mission is to help clients create and sustain competitive advantage. As a truly client\-focused firm, our highly trained and experienced consultants consider it their mandate to help client organizations achieve a quantum state.** 




  





**Position : Senior Automation Tester / Senior QA Automation Engineer** 




**Location: Pune/Nagpur, Maharashtra (Onsite)** 




**Duration: Full time** 




**Shift: UK Shift** 




  





**Job Description:**



* We are looking for an experienced Senior Automation Tester with strong expertise in Python, Robot Framework, and Selenium Library to develop, maintain, and enhance automated test solutions for web\-based applications.
* The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of automation framework design, test planning, execution, defect management, and Agile methodologies. The candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to ensure high\-quality software releases.








**Technical Environment:**



* **IDE: PyCharm 2023\.3\.1**
* **Programming Language: Python 3\.12\.1**
* **Automation Framework: Robot Framework**
* **Web Automation Library: Selenium Library**
* **Source Code Repository: Bitbucket**



  





**Core Technology Stack:**




**Python 3\.12\.1 \| Robot Framework \| Selenium Library \| Selenium \| PyCharm 2023\.3\.1 \| Bitbucket \| Git** 









**Key Responsibilities:**



* Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Robot Framework and Selenium Library.
* Develop reusable and maintainable automation components using Python.
* Analyze functional and technical requirements and create appropriate test scenarios and test cases.
* Build and enhance Robot Framework automation suites for functional, regression, integration, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Develop and maintain reusable keywords, libraries, test data, and automation utilities.
* Perform web application testing across supported browsers and environments.
* Identify suitable test cases for automation and maximize automation coverage.
* Execute automated regression suites and analyze test execution results.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and determine whether failures are caused by application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment issues.
* Log, track, and manage defects and work closely with development teams for resolution.
* Maintain automation source code and test assets in Bitbucket.
* Follow source\-control best practices, including branching, merging, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand\-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate with developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and other QA engineers.
* Review existing automation frameworks and identify opportunities for improved reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
* Create and maintain test documentation, automation standards, and execution reports.
* Mentor junior automation testers and provide guidance on Robot Framework, Python, SeleniumLibrary, and automation best practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and automation strategy.



  





**Required Technical Skills**




**Python** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Python for test automation.
* Good understanding of Python programming concepts, including:
* Functions and modules
* Classes and objects
* Exception handling
* Collections
* File handling
* Packages and libraries
* Ability to develop reusable Python utilities and automation libraries.



**Robot Framework** 



* Strong hands\-on experience with Robot Framework.
* Experience creating and maintaining Robot Framework test suites.
* Strong understanding of:
* Test cases and test suites
* User\-defined keywords
* Variables and variable files
* Resource files
* Tags
* Setup and teardown
* Test data management
* Test execution and reporting
* Experience integrating Python libraries with Robot Framework.
* Ability to develop scalable and maintainable Robot Framework automation frameworks.



**Selenium Library** 



* Strong experience with Selenium Library for web application automation.
* Experience working with:
* Locators
* Web elements
* XPath/CSS selectors
* Browser handling
* Wait mechanisms
* Windows and frames
* Alerts
* Dropdowns
* Dynamic web elements
* Experience troubleshooting Selenium synchronization and automation issues.



**Bitbucket / Source Control** 



* Hands\-on experience using Bitbucket for source code management.
* Good knowledge of Git commands and workflows.
* Experience with:
* Branching and merging
* Pull requests
* Code reviews
* Resolving merge conflicts
* Repository management
* Version control best practices



**Testing Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC.
* Experience in functional, regression, integration, system, and end\-to\-end testing.

title: Test Architect
description:
**Role:** 




 We're looking for a Test Architect to own our systems and integration testing strategy across complex, polyglot systems spanning C\+\+, Java and Python. Our test framework itself is written in Python, built on pytest, and we lean heavily on AI\-assisted development including Claude to build and extend it. You'll be the technical owner of that framework and the integration testing strategy behind it.
 



 This is a hands\-on architecture role, not a governance\-only position: you'll be writing Python/pytest day\-to\-day, building and evolving the framework, and working directly alongside engineers, while also acting as a client\-facing consultant understanding a stakeholder's technical challenges and driving the quality engineering roadmap that addresses them. Contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a useful tool in the kit, but it's a smaller part of the role than systems and integration testing
 



  





**Required Experience:** 



* 8\+ years as a Test Architect, Principal SDET, or senior test engineering leader, with proven ownership of systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong hands\-on Python development with deep pytest expertise — building and maintaining test automation frameworks, not just writing test cases.
* Track record testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments spanning C\+\+, Java, and Python.
* Comfortable reading, and ideally writing, C\+\+ and Java alongside Python.
* Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, plus client\-facing consulting experience influencing senior stakeholders and shaping a test strategy roadmap.
* Open to work from Pune or Bengaluru location



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the systems and integration testing strategy across polyglot components (C\+\+, Java, Python), architecting suites that validate behaviour across service and process boundaries.
* Design, build and maintain the test automation framework in Python/pytest the backbone of how we test using AI\-assisted development tools (including Claude) to accelerate framework development and maintenance.
* Embed systems and integration tests into CI/CD pipelines, so breaking changes are caught before they reach production.
* Apply contract testing (e.g. Pact) selectively where it adds real value, as a complement to not a replacement for — the systems/integration test strategy.
* Partner directly with client engineering leaders to diagnose quality gaps, and propose and drive adoption of the tools, frameworks and practices that close them.
* Mentor and upskill engineers on Python/pytest test engineering and integration testing best practice, raising the quality bar across the wider team.
* Define and evolve the test automation roadmap for the engagement, balancing coverage, speed and maintainability.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Proven experience as a Test Architect, Principal SDET or similar, having designed and led systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong, hands\-on Python skills with deep pytest expertise this is the language and framework the test suite is built on.
* A track record of testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments.
* Comfortable reading (and ideally writing) C\+\+ and Java, since the systems under test span both alongside Python.
* Enthusiasm for using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build and maintain test tooling and frameworks.
* Some exposure to contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a nice to have, and not the focus of the role.
* Experience embedding automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Confidence operating as a client\-facing consultant: comfortable influencing senior technical stakeholders and shaping strategy, not just executing against a backlog.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate testing strategy into business outcomes for both engineers and clients.
